items.question: What is Ergo?
items.answer: Ergo is a secure, open-source Proof-of-Work blockchain for programmable, censorship-resistant money. It uses the eUTXO model combining Bitcoin's security with smart contract capabilities, optional privacy, and predictable low fees (~$0.01).

items.question: How to buy ERG?
items.answer: You can buy ERG on exchanges like KuCoin, Gate.io, or Bitpanda, and through verified non-custodial routes where active liquidity exists. Spectrum Finance is a historical Ergo DEX reference with a 2024 sunset notice, so verify current venues before trading. First get a wallet (Nautilus, SAFEW, or Ergo Mobile Wallet), then purchase ERG and withdraw to your wallet address.

items.question: Is Ergo a good investment?
items.answer: Ergo has a fixed supply of 97.7M ERG with no pre-mine and fair launch. It's a Proof-of-Work blockchain with unique technology (eUTXO, Sigma Protocols). As with any cryptocurrency, do your own research and only invest what you can afford to lose.

items.question: Why is Ergo a strong fit for autonomous work settlement?
items.answer: Ergo's eUTXO model gives deterministic transaction costs, ErgoScript can encode acceptance rules, Babel Fees reduce native-token bootstrapping, and receipt-bearing workflows can connect payment, task verification and settlement. The current agent-economy stack is presented as testnet-first proof until audit gates open.

items.question: How to get started with Ergo?
items.answer: 1) Download a wallet (Nautilus for browser, Ergo Mobile Wallet for phone). 2) Back up your seed phrase securely. 3) Get ERG from an exchange or verified non-custodial route. 4) Explore SigmaUSD, ErgoMixer, NFTs, mining, and current DeFi venues after checking each project's status.

items.question: What wallets support Ergo?
items.answer: Popular Ergo wallets include Nautilus (browser extension), SAFEW (full-featured web wallet), Ergo Mobile Wallet (iOS/Android), Terminus (mobile), and Satergo (desktop). Hardware wallet support is available through Ledger integration.
